prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: high-resolution service-card photograph for «Продвижение бренда» (brand promotion), landscape 8:5, final web delivery 1440×900. Generate the highest native landscape resolution available, ideally at least 1600×1000.
Primary request: an immediately understandable, premium realistic scene showing ONE coherent consumer brand being promoted through outdoor advertising and a social-media campaign. The concept is brand visibility and recognition across channels, rather than a shop interior or a collection of stationery.
Scene: a beautiful contemporary European city sidewalk in soft natural afternoon light. In the middle distance a real glass bus-stop advertising lightbox carries a handsome, professionally designed coffee campaign for a fictional brand named «ЛИНИЯ». The campaign has a large dark-navy Cyrillic wordmark «ЛИНИЯ», a warm ivory background, a clean cyan accent and a beautiful appetizing espresso photograph. The exact small descriptor is «КОФЕ КАЖДЫЙ ДЕНЬ». A subtle coffee-shop frontage bearing the SAME «ЛИНИЯ» wordmark is in the soft-focus background. At the front, a single person's hand naturally holds a realistic modern smartphone showing the same brand's social-media campaign post with the identical wordmark, palette and espresso photo. The phone is not cropped off; its screen is clearly recognizable, the person is mostly out of frame. The ad lightbox and phone are both major readable subjects, each occupying substantial visual area.
Composition: photographed as one physically coherent scene with natural perspective, no collage, no floating screen or graphic overlay. Wide horizontal framing. Important ad creative, phone and hand stay inside the central 80% for a 1440×900 crop. Phone at foreground right; ad lightbox at middle left, with balanced optical weight and depth. No excessive empty sky or blank wall. The hero subjects should remain understandable when displayed at 600×375.
Style: premium commercial editorial photography, rich true-to-life paper/glass/metal textures, optically believable soft depth of field, excellent clean exposure, natural shadows, restrained navy/cyan/ivory brand colors, authentic urban environment, fine realistic detail and razor-sharp main subjects, no over-retouching.
Constraints: fictional demonstration campaign, not a real agency client or case study; no fabricated performance statistics, no charts, no awards, no real customer data. Typography on the two main campaign placements must be neat and consistent. No abstract objects, no glowing networks, no futuristic holograms, no retail stationery display, no watermark. No website layout or surrounding interface outside the photographed phone. One anatomically correct natural hand with five fingers, no duplicated objects. All text in Russian except incidental OS icons.
